report.summary: Australians should note a national warning that AI-driven scams and account takeovers are growing, with reported losses at AUD $2.18 billion in 2025, and a reported USD $6.3 billion Binance theft that started with a tampered software package and a fake hiring process. Globally, actively exploited critical flaws dominate: Check Point gateway intrusions with wiper attacks, a Cisco BroadWorks flaw on CISA's KEV list, and Microsoft's five CVSS 9.8 Windows service fixes. Patch perimeter and core infrastructure urgently.

items.title: CVE-2026-123039: Check Point Gateway Exploited Privilege Escalation Fixed in R82.20 Take 14
items.why: CVE-2026-123039 is being exploited in the wild and on KEV; root-level compromise of Check Point gateways plus wiper activity means unpatched perimeter appliances are urgent patch targets.

items.title: Unpatched Check Point Gateways Are Being Wiped exploiting PHP2Shell
items.why: Unpatched Check Point gateways are being actively exploited since 30 October via the Mobile Access portal, with backdoors and destructive wiper attacks — treat missing patches as urgent.

items.title: Critical Windows Kerberos, LDAP, DNS, DHCP and iSCSI Flaws Rated CVSS 9.8 Patched in November 2026
items.why: Microsoft's November 2026 patches fix five CVSS 9.8 flaws in core Windows services — Kerberos, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, iSCSI — so domain controllers and core network infrastructure need priority patching.
